sevenrooms.basis: Bookings are reservation rows by booking-created date, Europe/Paris, is_deleted false, bar seating areas excluded. Website = Booking Widget plus the three named landing-page sources at this venue. Gross includes rows later cancelled, so weeks are comparable irrespective of settlement age; net excludes them.

GENERATOR AUTO-INSIGHTS, checked against the code rather than assumed. (1) 'Google is the more efficient platform' CANNOT recur: the generator guards it with gcpa && mcpa and Google has zero bookings, so gcpa is 0 and the insight is suppressed. All three flagged, generator NOT modified.
